messages.pass: Admin path is non-default and not trivially guessable.
messages.fail: Admin path is default, weak, or missing. Change env.php backend.frontName to a non-guessable value and update web server rules.

messages.pass: Two-Factor Authentication core and at least one provider module are enabled for admin.
messages.fail: Two-Factor Authentication is disabled, missing, or has no enabled provider module. Enable Magento_TwoFactorAuth and at least one admin 2FA provider.

rules.title: Admin passwords require at least 8 characters

messages.pass: Admin password policy requires at least 8 characters.
messages.fail: Admin password minimum length is missing or lower than 8 characters. Configure a minimum of 8 characters; 15 or more is strongly recommended.

messages.pass: Admin session lifetime is at or below 900 seconds.
messages.fail: Admin session lifetime is missing or exceeds 900 seconds. Reduce admin/security/session_lifetime to ≤ 900 for better security.

messages.pass: Admin URL is either non-default or network-restricted (deny/allow rules present).
messages.fail: Admin URL is exposed (default path and no network ACLs). Change backend.frontName and/or restrict access via web server allow/deny.

messages.pass: CAPTCHA, reCAPTCHA, or login lockout protection is enabled for admin authentication.
messages.fail: CAPTCHA/rate-limiting protection is weak or missing. Enable admin CAPTCHA, reCAPTCHA, or login lockout controls.

messages.pass: Active Magento Admin users have valid role and ACL assignments.
messages.fail: Invalid Magento Admin user, role, or ACL relationships were detected. Repair orphaned assignments and ensure every active admin user inherits a role with explicit ACL rules.

rules.title: Global Admin ACL limited to approved roles

messages.pass: Global Magento Admin ACL access is limited to approved roles and users.
messages.fail: Unapproved roles or users inherit global Magento Admin ACL access. Remove Magento_Backend::all or document narrowly scoped break-glass exceptions.

rules.title: PCI vendor default account evidence assessment

args.review: Confirm every in-scope component is inventoried; verify retained vendor default accounts changed their default password and unused vendor default accounts are disabled or removed.

remediation: Inventory vendor default accounts for every in-scope system component.
Change the vendor default password for every retained account according to the applicable password policy.
Remove or disable every vendor default account that is not used.
Record evidence using the PCI DSS 2.2.2 Magebean evidence schema and complete independent human verification.
